geometry_bands.source_anchor: MOBILE CHASING VORTEX — an independently-moving blade-vortex entity that PURSUES nearby enemies, damaging everything it passes through; up to 10 active blades, hits every 0.2s, 5s duration, 2 stored uses (post-3.14). NOT player-orbiting (regular BV is the orbit skill; the dossier contrast is explicit) — do not read this as orbit. Geometry per R-M6 drift-tick precedent: circle + behavioral note; the enemy-SEEKING travel exceeds R-M6's drift class.
